intent: Set the mark rate to 25% for all lines on my draft proposal for a customer.
actions: With the Margin module and Display mark rates enabled, open my draft proposal for a customer. It contains two free-text service lines priced at EUR100 and EUR50, with buying costs EUR80 and EUR40 respectively and initial mark rates of 20%.
Click the edit icon in the Mark rate column header and wait for the rate field to appear.
Click Update and wait for the proposal card to refresh.
